messages:
sanjay: Quick heads-up — saw a 2x p95 jump on SXM nodes in us-west when running redwood-7b-v0.3 int8 KV-cache throughput tests. Attached charts (latency vs throughput). Anyone seen region-specific SXM regressions?

marta: Oof. Can you paste the numbers/configs?

sanjay: Baseline run (seq=1024, batch=4, continuous batching=on, quant=int8, kernel=flash-attn-v2, numa_pin=false):
- pcie nodes (g5x): p50=38ms p95=92ms throughput≈220 rps
- sxm nodes (us-west): p50=34ms p95=185ms throughput≈210 rps
So p95 doubled on SXM in us-west only. EU-central SXM looks normal (~96ms p95).

kevin: Any NVLink or PCIe errors in dmesg/syslog? Also check cpu->gpu affinity and IRQ balance. Could be firmware/driver mismatch per-rack.

sanjay: Quick dmesg snippet from an affected host: 
```
[  123.456789] nvidia: nvlink: link 1 down, attempt recover
[  124.102345] nv_peer_mem: peer memory registered
```
Not a ton of errors but saw occasional link flaps earlier in the run. infra-bot health check says NVLink=OK on average.

caroline: Two quick levers: enable NUMA pinning + try a different attention kernel (we've seen flash-attn-v2 regress on long seqs with certain NVLink topologies). On a past run turning on numa_pin dropped p95 on SXM from ~170ms to ~95ms.

benchbot: Automated summary: 10k requests sampled across regions.
- us-west (SXM): p95 anomaly 180ms (flagged)
- us-east (SXM): p95 102ms
- eu-central (SXM): p95 96ms
NVLink health aggregate: OK. No cluster-wide fw mismatch detected.

marta: Also try switching --attn-backend=triton and temporarily disable continuous batching to isolate whether KV-cache sharing is interacting with batching heuristics.

sanjay: Rolled a canary pool in us-west (4 SXM nodes) with: numa_pin=true, attn_backend=triton, continuous_batching=off. Early numbers after 30m:
- p50=36ms p95=101ms throughput≈218 rps.
So p95 back to expected range and throughput slightly up (+4%). Keeping canary for 2 hours.

kevin: If canary holds we should update kernel selection heuristic: prefer triton for seq>=512 on SXM in us-west until root cause found. Also add an automatic canary flag when p95 deviation >30%.

caroline: Filing infra ticket to check rack-7 nvlink firmware and board-level cabling — saw older nvlink fw on a subset of hosts last month. Ticket INC-4529 created and linked to this thread.

sanjay: Created INC-4529 with links to canary logs and perf dumps. Will post final numbers after 2h. Thanks all :thumbsup:

marta: Nice triage. If canary is stable let's also run a quantization sanity (int8 vs q4) to sanity-check kernel-quant interactions.

benchbot: Canary monitor: 15m windows — p95 trending down to ~100ms, no new nvlink flaps detected.

sanjay: Good sign. Leaving canary running, will escalate to rollout if stable.
